steps.en: Clone the template, install, and copy the config
steps.zh: 克隆模板、装依赖、复制配置

steps.en: Connect a CopilotKit Intelligence project (hosted or local Docker evaluation)
steps.zh: 接上 Intelligence 项目（托管或本地评估版）
steps.code: npx copilotkit@latest login · npx copilotkit@latest project select

steps.en: Add the model key and model name to .env, then start the app
steps.zh: 在 .env 填模型 key 和模型名，启动应用

steps.en: Serves the workspace at 127.0.0.1:5173: Spaces and pages in SQLite, chats as Intelligence Threads
steps.zh: 提供工作区：页面存 SQLite，对话存 Intelligence

component.zh: Node 服务与 React 应用

steps.en: Define a Dot: name, role, instructions, permitted tools and Spaces
steps.zh: 定义一个 Dot：名字、角色、指令、允许的工具和 Space

steps.en: Runs its turns from chat, Slack, calls or schedules and streams browser and tool cards inline
steps.zh: 从聊天、Slack、通话或定时任务接活，把浏览器和工具卡片流回聊天

steps.en: Stops at Approve & save / Approve & run before saving a page or running a write tool
steps.zh: 存页面或调写操作工具前停下，等你点批准

value.en: A named specialist keeps one conversation, its files and its browser across text, calls and Slack — and nothing is saved or written outside without your click
value.zh: 有名字的专职 Dot 在文字、通话、Slack 间共用一段对话和一台浏览器；不经你点头，什么都不存、不外写

sources: https://github.com/CopilotKit/OpenDots/blob/main/README.md Get started (git clone, npm ci, cp .env.example .env, npm run dev, http://127.0.0.1:5173, npx copilotkit@latest login, npx copilotkit@latest project select, OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_MODEL)
